name: Publicans
overview: The publicans, or tax collectors, were widely despised and suspected of extortion, yet Scripture reveals their significant role in the gospel narrative. Matthew, a publican from Capernaum, exemplifies transformation as he leaves his post to follow Christ and becomes an apostle. Jesus’ association with publicans, as noted by the Pharisees, highlights His willingness to reach out to those marginalized and regarded as sinners. Moreover, the publicans are used in teaching to challenge believers to love beyond their comfort, as seen in Jesus’ rhetorical questions about loving only those who love us.
